needQueryOrUrl:
Give me a song/video name or a link.
Ex: `{{cmd}} song name`
error: Couldn't process it. Try again later.
playlistAskName:
Choose the playlist name in your next message. Send just the name.

_'cancelar' to cancel_
playlistCreated:
✅ Playlist `{{name}}` created!

Add songs whenever you want:
`!mp3 playlist {{name}} add <name/link>`
`!mp3 playlist add tocando` — adds the last played song

Other useful commands:
`!mp3 playlist {{name}} info` — list the songs
`!mp3 playlist {{name}} del <index>` — remove a song
`!mp3 playlist {{name}} zip` — download everything as .zip
`!mp3 playlist {{name}} del` — delete the playlist
`!mp3 playlist list` — list your playlists
playlistLimitReached: Limit reached ({{max}} songs) for this playlist.
playlistMaxPerUserReached:
You already have the max of {{max}} playlists.
Delete one with `!mp3 playlist <name> del` to create another.
playlistInvalidName:
Invalid name.
Use letters, numbers, `_` or `-`, no spaces.
Avoid: `list`, `info`, `zip`, `del`, `add`.
playlistNameTaken:
You already have a playlist `{{name}}`.
Try another name.
playlistReady:
🎶 Playlist `{{name}}` is ready!
Use `!mp3 playlist {{name}}` to play it.
playlistMp3Only:
🎵 Playlists only exist on `!mp3`.
Use `!mp3 playlist` to create or play one.
playlistNotReadyYet:
⏳ Playlist `{{name}}` is still downloading.
Wait for the ready notice.
(`... info` shows progress)
playlistLoadEmpty:
🎵 Playlist `{{name}}` has no songs yet.
Add one with `!mp3 playlist {{name}} add <name/link>`.
playlistListEmpty:
No saved playlists.
Create one with `!mp3 playlist`.
playlistAddNeedQuery:
Give me a song or link.
Ex: `!mp3 playlist <n> add song`
playlistAddConfirm:
🔎 *{{title}}* - {{channel}} ({{duration}})

Add to `{{name}}`?
*yes* to confirm, anything else cancels.
playlistRemoveInvalidIndex:
Invalid number.
Use the index from `... info` (1-{{count}}).
playlistAddCurrentHint: _`!{{cmd}} playlist add tocando` adds this song_
playlistAddCurrentUsage:
Use `!mp3 playlist add tocando`
to add the last played song.
playlistAddCurrentNone: No recently played song to add.
usage:
*!{{cmd}}* — download and send audio/video

`!{{cmd}} <name/url>` — search or download
`!{{cmd}} playlist` — create a new playlist
`!{{cmd}} playlist list` — list your playlists
`!{{cmd}} playlist <n>` — play the playlist
`!{{cmd}} playlist <n> info` — list songs (with index)
`!{{cmd}} playlist <n> add <name/url>` — add a song
`!{{cmd}} playlist add tocando` — add the last played song
`!{{cmd}} playlist <n> del <index>` — remove a song
`!{{cmd}} playlist <n> zip` — download as .zip
`!{{cmd}} playlist <n> del` — delete the playlist
usageVideo:
*!{{cmd}}* — download and send video

`!{{cmd}} <name/url>` — search or download

_Playlists are mp3-only._
